title: Children of a shallow gate are literals
statement: Let $m\in\mathbb N$, choose an AND or OR gate, and let $cs$ be a list of Boolean circuit trees on $m$ variables. If the circuit formed by applying that gate to the children in $cs$ has depth at most $1$, then every child in $cs$ is a literal.
hypotheses_covered: Gate type is AND or OR
List cs of circuit trees on m variables
The circuit formed from the gate and cs has depth at most 1
replaced:
Fix a number of variables $m$, a gate type $isAnd \in \{\mathrm{true},
\mathrm{false}\}$, and a list $cs$ of Boolean circuits on $m$ variables, and form the
circuit $\mathrm{node}(isAnd, cs)$ whose root gate is applied to the children in $cs$.
If this circuit has depth at most $1$, then every child $c$ in $cs$ is a literal; that
is, there exists a literal $l$ with $c = \mathrm{lit}(l)$.
